content.text:
* OTA-FREE-SKY130 : two-stage telescopic-cascode Miller OTA (v4)
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* ---- bias network ----
XM_B1 IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=34 L=2
XM_B6 VBP VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=50 L=1.2
XM_B7 VBP IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=34 L=2
* NB2 = vgs(diode) + 10u*62k   (nmos cascode gate)
XM_B2 NB2 VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=50 L=1.2
R1 NB2 ND 62000
XM_B3 ND ND VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=34 L=2
* PD = VDD - |vgs| - 10u*45k  (pmos cascode gate)
XM_B5 PBP PBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=50 L=1.2
R3 PBP PD 45000
XM_B4 PD IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=34 L=2
* ---- first stage : telescopic cascode ----
XM0 T IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=1.2
XM1 A VINN T VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=60 L=1
XM2 B VINP T VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=60 L=1
XM7 N1 NB2 A VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=44 L=2
XM8 N2 NB2 B VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=44 L=2
XM3 C1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.3
XM4 C2 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.3
XM5 N1 PD C1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.3
XM6 N2 PD C2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.3
* ---- second stage ----
XM9 VOUT N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.3
XM10 VOUT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.15 m=2
* ---- miller compensation ----
RZ N2 Z 3000
CC Z VOUT 2.25e-12
.ends DUT
